subject: Request: SDLC proof points and redacted trails for SOC 2 review
body:
From: Olive Risk <assessor@oliverisk.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liao <t.liao@finbank.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 - SDLC artifacts needed for evidence sampling

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to provide sample artifacts for our upcoming SOC 2 readiness review. We need a small, redacted set of records that demonstrate your secure SDLC controls in practice. Specifically, could you provide:

- Representative code-review transcripts (PR and review comments) showing peer review and approval gates
- CI/CD run output for a typical release pipeline (build, tests, policy checks) — redacted if necessary
- Secrets/KMS access snapshot showing key custodians and recent rotations (or a redacted extract)
- Change management records showing approvals for a production change (ticket, approver, timestamp)

Please aim for a single zip with redaction notes. We only need 1–2 examples per control area — no more than necessary. Also include the policy or runbook references that map each artifact to the control (e.g., PR review policy, CI gating doc).

Best,
Maya Patel
Senior Assessor, Olive Risk
assessor@oliverisk.com

--

On Fri, 2 Mar 2028 at 10:03 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Olive Risk <assessor@oliverisk.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Tom Liao <t.liao@finbank.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 - SDLC artifacts needed for evidence sampling

Hi Maya,

Thanks — we can provide a small redacted package. To make sure we send the best samples, quick clarifications:

1) For code review examples, do you prefer a full PR thread (with comments) or a flattened export that highlights reviewer approvals and link to the PR?
2) For CI/CD traces, we can provide the pipeline logs for a representative release plus a short README mapping log sections to control checks. Is that sufficient?
3) For KMS/secrets, we will export an access snapshot showing key roles and last-rotation timestamps; we will redact principal IDs.
4) For change approvals, we can include the Jira ticket printout and the approval email chain.

Irene, Jordan — looping you in for the artifacts. Jordan, can you pull the CI run for the 2028-02-24 release and the PR export for the feature branch "opt/runtime-batching"? Irene, please prepare a redacted KMS access export and the change log for the hotfix on 2028-01-18.

We will prepare a zipped bundle and upload to a shared Drive link. We also need to include a short mapping doc (control -> artifact).

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 - SDLC artifacts needed for evidence sampling

Kimberly / Irene,

Quick status update on the artifacts requested:

- Code review: exported PR thread for feature/opt/runtime-batching. I removed contributor emails and replaced account IDs with role labels (e.g., reviewer:frontend-team). The export includes timestamps, comment bodies, and the final approval.
- CI traces: pipeline run "release-2028-02-24" exported to PDF and annotated with markers where static-analysis and gating policies ran.
- Change approval: ticket SEC-1198 (hotfix) export attached; contains approver, change window, and rollback notes.

I uploaded the preliminary bundle to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3xExampleDriveLink (permissions: Olive Risk and FinBank Security).

Attachments in the upload: 20280302-code-review-samples.zip, ci-traces-sample.pdf, change-approval-audit.csv

Jordan Blake
Security Engineer (Platform)
Redwood Inference

--

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Olive Risk <assessor@oliverisk.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 - SDLC artifacts needed for evidence sampling

Hi Maya / Kimberly,

I've prepared the KMS access snapshot and a short secrets management notes file. Per policy, we redacted principal identifiers and any customer-specific values. Files uploaded include: kms-access-snapshot.csv and secrets-management-runbook-extract.pdf.

One note for the assessor: the kms snapshot shows role bindings at the time of export (2028-03-02). Our rotation cadence is quarterly; the snapshot includes a last-rotation column. If you need an expanded time series for rotation history I can extract that (it will take ~1h).

Also attached a mapping doc (control_mapping.md) that links each artifact to the SOC 2 criteria sections you requested.

Attachments: kms-access-snapshot.csv, secrets-management-runbook-extract.pdf, control_mapping.md

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Manager, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

--

[Thread notes]
- Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3xExampleDriveLink
- HubSpot intake: HS-40271
- Jira ticket referenced in artifacts: SEC-1198

Attachments referenced (redacted sample artifacts):
- 20280302-code-review-samples.zip (PR export: comments redacted, reviewer roles substituted)
- ci-traces-sample.pdf (annotated CI pipeline trace for release-2028-02-24)
- kms-access-snapshot.csv (redacted role bindings and last-rotation timestamps)
- change-approval-audit.csv (ticket SEC-1198 export with approver and timestamps)

If Olive Risk confirms the bundle is sufficient we will prepare a final signed transmittal and record the exchange in our SOC 2 evidence log.

End of thread.
